Business Purpose

Saitama Prefecture provides financial support for implementation costs of DX tools* that help small and medium-sized enterprises improve productivity as they work toward sustained growth.

Applications for this subsidy will begin on July 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8, Wednesday). We encourage you to consider improving productivity through DX during this opportunity.

*DX tools that streamline business operations through digital technology, such as cashless payment systems, accounting software, and group collaboration platforms.

Subsidy Overview

The subsidy covers:
• Purchase costs of DX tools that support productivity improvements*1
• Digital equipment purchase costs needed to operate the DX tools, plus expenses for installation, transportation, setup, and other implementation work*2

*1 Includes lease fees and subscription costs (up to 12 months maximum)
*2 Up to one-half of total eligible expenses

For More Information

For full details, please visit the website or review the subsidy application guide (flyer) linked below.

■Saitama Prefecture Small & Medium Enterprise DX Implementation Support Subsidy

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2680/
